_doc: Prompts for the engine's sound effects, used by `npm run sfx` (tools/gen_sfx.mjs, ElevenLabs). Each generated file assets/sfx/<name>.mp3 replaces the built-in synthesised sound with the same name (see RECIPES in src/ui/audio_bank.gd). seconds: 0.5-30 or omit for automatic length.

dice.prompt: Polyhedral dice rattling and tumbling across a wooden table, close up, dry

dice_land.prompt: A single heavy die landing and settling on a wooden table, short

hit.prompt: Sword striking leather armor, short meaty impact, fantasy combat

crit.prompt: Powerful critical sword blow with metallic ring and impact, fantasy combat

miss.prompt: Sword swinging through air and missing, quick whoosh

cast.prompt: Magic spell being cast, shimmering arcane energy rising, short

heal.prompt: Gentle healing magic chime, warm and soft

coin.prompt: A few gold coins clinking into a pouch

item.prompt: Picking up a small item, soft leather rustle and click

door.prompt: Heavy old wooden door creaking open, dungeon

quest.prompt: Short hopeful fantasy harp flourish, new quest notification

quest_done.prompt: Short triumphant fantasy fanfare with horns, quest completed

levelup.prompt: Bright ascending magical chime, level up

combat.prompt: War drums hit three times, battle begins, short and tense

victory.prompt: Short heroic victory fanfare, brass and drums

down.prompt: A body collapsing to the ground in armor, heavy thud

join.prompt: Warm two note lute phrase, a companion joins

rest.prompt: Crackling campfire with a soft lullaby note fading out

drink.prompt: Drinking a potion from a small glass bottle, gulp
